description: WFIGS Current Interagency Fire Perimeters is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Best available perimeters for recent and ongoing wildland fires in the United States The Wildland Fire Interagency Geospatial Services (WFIGS) Group provides authoritative geospatial data products under the interagency Wildland Fire Data Program. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Natural Hazards. Its keywords are natural hazards, wildfire. The portal shows 2025-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is The National Interagency Fire Center Custom License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
